name_zh: 伊本·沙乌德/阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹：瓦哈比伊斯兰教法治理与国家建构
name_en: Ibn Saud/Abdulaziz: Wahhabi Islamic Governance & State-Building
description_zh: 阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·本·阿卜杜勒-拉赫曼·阿勒沙特 (1875-1953) 即伊本·沙乌德，以瓦哈比教义为意识形态核心，通过 Najd 根据地→收复利雅得 (1902)→征服哈萨 (1913)→统一希贾兹 (1925)→建立沙特阿拉伯王国 (1932)。核心治理机制：瓦哈比教法 (Hanbali 学派严格字面主义) 即国家法律、乌里玛 (宗教学者集团) 通过舒拉 (协商) 制衡王权、部落联盟 (伊赫万) 作为军事动员基础、石油收益 (1938 年发现) 分配确立社会契约。体现 M161 瓦克夫式伊斯兰现代慈善治理——宗教捐赠永久化、收益专款专用、社区自治管理，以及 M168 石油地缘战略。
description_en: Abdulaziz bin Abdulrahman Al Saud (1875-1953) aka Ibn Saud, with Wahhabi doctrine as ideological core, from Najd base -> recaptured Riyadh (1902) -> conquered Al-Hasa (1913) -> unified Hejaz (1925) -> established Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (1932). Core governance mechanism: Wahhabi fiqh (Hanbali strict literalism) as state law, Ulama (religious scholars) check royal power via Shura (consultation), tribal alliance (Ikhwan) as military mobilization base, oil revenue (discovered 1938) distribution establishing social contract. Exemplifies M161 Waqf-style Islamic Modern Philanthropic Governance—religious endowments perpetual, proceeds earmarked, community self-governance—and M168 Oil/Mineral Geostrategy.
reason_zh: 沙特建国非单纯军事征服，而是"教义+部落+教法"三位一体国家建构：瓦哈比教义提供合法性，伊赫万提供军事力量，教法提供治理框架。M161+M168 结合，区隔于 M149 伊斯兰咨询(决策)、M173 哈希姆合法性(血统)，核心在于"教法即宪法、部落即军队、石油即社会契约"。
reason_en: Saudi state-building not mere military conquest but trinity of "doctrine+tribe+fiqh": Wahhabi doctrine provides legitimacy, Ikhwan provides military force, fiqh provides governance framework. M161+M168 combined, distinct from M149 Islamic Shura (decision-making) and M173 Hashemite Legitimacy (lineage), core: "fiqh as constitution, tribe as army, oil as social contract".
steps_zh: 教义合法性确立：1744 年沙特-瓦哈比盟约，教义即政治纲领
部落军事动员：伊赫万定居点化游牧部落，宗教狂热转化为征服动力
教法治理制度化：乌里玛委员会审议立法、司法独立于行政、哈奈菲/罕百里并存
石油社会契约锚定：1938 年达曼一号井→阿美公司合资→收益分配/免税/福利国家
现代化转型管理：法赫德国王 (1975-1982) 基建/教育/工业化，阿卜杜拉 (2005-2015) 女性权利/司法改革/MBS 2030 愿景
steps_en: Doctrinal legitimacy establishment: 1744 Saudi-Wahhabi pact, doctrine as political platform
Tribal military mobilization: Ikhwan settlements sedentarize nomads, religious zeal converts to conquest drive
Fiqh governance institutionalization: Ulama council reviews legislation, judiciary independent from admin, Hanafi/Hanbali coexistence
Oil social contract anchoring: 1938 Dammam No.1 -> Aramco JV -> revenue distribution/tax-free/welfare state
Modernization transition management: Fahd (1975-82) infra/education/industrialization, Abdullah (2005-15) women rights/judicial reform/MBS Vision 2030
expected_zh: 部落联盟以"教法即宪法、石油为契约"机制建立现代国家，在传统教义与现代化压力中实现政权延续与战略自主。
expected_en: Tribal alliance builds modern state via "fiqh as constitution, oil as contract" mechanism, achieving regime continuity & strategic autonomy amid traditional doctrine & modernization pressures.
case_zh: 1902 收复利雅得→1932 建国→1938 发现石油→1973 石油禁运确立能源超级大国地位→2016 Vision 2030 启动后石油转型，90 年政权零更迭。
case_en: 1902 Riyadh recaptured -> 1932 state founded -> 1938 oil discovered -> 1973 oil embargo establishes energy superpower status -> 2016 Vision 2030 launches post-oil transition, 90 years zero regime change.
cross_cultural_impact: Wahhabi model for Islamic governance; OPEC founding; petrodollar recycling; Vision 2030 reform benchmark
colonial_history: Ottoman suzerainty nominal; British protectorate relations 1915-1927
resource_curse_mitigation: Aramco 50/50 profit sharing (1950) -> full nationalization (1980); SAMA sovereign wealth management; Vision 2030 diversification
